messages:
alex: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel selector tweak I see a latency regression on model-x for short sequences (<64 tokens). 95p increased ~30ms on the hosted path. KV hit ratio also dropped ~6% for those requests.

sophia: Do you have the profiler traces? small-seq regressions usually mean wrong kernel or extra memcpy.

alex: Quick paste from perf trace: 
```
allocation: fused_attn_small chosen for seq=32
but runtime falls back to generic_attn when kv_enabled=true -> extra copy + different kernel path
batch shapes: many 1-token and 2-token mini-batches, avg batch_size=2.1
estimated_tokens_in_flight: peaked at 1.6M vs target 1.2M
```

raj: If batch formation has lots of tiny batches, we should tighten the batching window or lower token_budget for the short-seq traffic. Can we route those clients to a smaller token_budget policy?

elena: Kernel picker currently buckets by declared seq_len only. For kv-enabled requests effective sequence = seq_len + kv_header_len, which bumps some 32->48 then falls into wrong kernel bucket. We should compute effective_generation_tokens before selecting kernel.

sophia: Another lever is admission: introduce a soft-admit bias for kv-hit requests so they get priority in the batch when kv cache will reduce per-token compute. Something like `kv_admit_bias = 1.2` that increases admit probability.

alex: Proposal for quick canary: 
- change kernel picker to use effective_generation_tokens (seq + kv_header) but prefer small-kernel when kv_hit==true
- lower token_budget target from 512 -> 128 for this route
- reduce batch_timeout_ms from 12 -> 6 for short-seq clients
- add soft-429 when est_tokens_in_flight > token_budget * 1.1

code snippet I plan to deploy: 
```
# runtime config fragment
route: /model-x/short-seq
token_budget: 128
batch_timeout_ms: 6
kv_admit_bias: 1.2
soft_429_threshold_ratio: 1.1
```

raj: Soft-429 rule is fine but prefer graceful shedding: return a retry-after + hint to use smaller prompt. Also emit metric `admit.reject_reason=soft_token_budget` so we can track.

elena: Agree on kernel change but test perf impact — fused_attn_small has different memory layout; switching when kv_hit==true could cause corner-case OOM. Add a quick mem-sanity check in canary.

perf-bot: CI perf run queued: https://ci.internal/runs/4589 (will include p95/p99 histograms and kv-hit breakdown) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sophia: Awesome. Alex — can you run the canary with traffic shadowing for 1 hour and post p50/p95/p99 + kv-hit ratio? If we see 95p back to baseline and kv-hit improves, we roll.

alex: On it. I'll post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
